scope: Bounded running-interpreter file continuity against a separate exact pin; no native version probe or execution grant
limits: Only the same resolved running interpreter and a single executable command are observed; other selections require their acknowledged native owner.
The expected identity must be supplied independently by current importer and qualified interpreter authority; this helper cannot establish that authority.
Explicit finite file and metadata ceilings bound the existing pinned-input reader.
All ADR0061 public/current-provider, packaging, origin, complete-consumer and receipt requirements remain pending.
